[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 18]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Award of a three (3)-year Contract to Alcott Center for Mental Health Services: With two (2) one-year renewal options, covering intensive case management and terminal outreach services to people experiencing homelessness at Los Angeles International Airport and other Los Angeles World Airports properties, for cost not to exceed $1,050,000 (Glenda Silva)
summary: Approval of the Award of a three (3)-year Contract to Alcott Center for Mental Health Services.
